description: Execution contract for a conceptual or methodological argument. Its method is constructing, reconstructing and testing the argument (the chain of inference, rival explanations); its products are conceptual propositions, argument conclusions and a framework, which are research outputs in their own right. It requires no dataset, no estimator and no separate empirical results section, and does not read the absence of them as missing evidence; a manuscript need not have Methods and Results headings. The argument is held to the standards of a conceptual claim (clarity, coherence, consistency of assumptions, rivals, boundaries). Independent of discipline. Status EXTRACTED.

contribution.activity: stating the argument and what it claims to add

literature.activity: the prior theory and argument the new argument responds to
literature.manuscript: theoretical background, or woven into the argument

methods.activity: the method of constructing, reconstructing and testing the argument
methods.manuscript: the argument's structure and approach, which a conceptual paper may merge with its main text

results.activity: the conceptual products: propositions, argument conclusions, the framework
results.manuscript: the argument's main sections; no empirical Results section is implied

discussion.activity: implications and limits of the argument

steps.title: State the argument and what it concludes (a conceptual Claim)
Account for the prior theory the argument responds to (a landscape of it, or the researcher's recorded account)
Reconstruct the chain of inference and the assumptions it needs
Treat rival explanations and prior theory (the researcher's reading; recorded)

on_condition.reason: a rival explanation is not answered by the chain as reconstructed: reconstruct it again with the rival in view

steps.title: Set out the propositions, argument conclusions and framework (the research product)
Implications of the argument and what it does not show (recorded)
